verdict.rationale: Zep is an agent-memory and Context Graph service with no user-defined automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. The evidence on API path versioning, SDK deprecation waves, and graph cloning concerns API and data versions, not user automations, so it does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
